segments.he: הדרך ארץ שהי' אצל רבינו ז"ל אין לשער. ורבינו ז"ל אמר שמלכים צריכין לשלוח אליו בניהם ללמוד א"ע דרך ארץ. ופ"א הי' רבינו ז"ל עם אנשיו על השלחן בליל א' דר"ה וחטפו את המוציא עם דבש. וכעס רבינו ז"ל ואמר כמו ילדים קטנים המוציא עם דבש. אז וויא קליינע יונגליק המוציא מיט המניק והלך מהשלחן ולא הי' אז על השלחן עמהם מפני זה.
segments.en: I heard: after Rabbainu's passing, on the first Shabbos, the disciples of Rabbainu were gathered in Rabbainu's house. Reb Yudel said he would sit in Rabbainu's chair — because he had inherited Rabbainu's shtreiml. And other disciples answered him. Then Moharan'as arose and said that he would sit in the chair — because he had inherited the mochin [higher mind] of Rabbainu. For tefillin is mochin — and once Rabbainu had been traveling and asked Moharan'as for his Rabbainu Tam tefillin, wore them, and returned them. Moharan'as sat in the chair and began to sing Azamer Bishvachin with great arousal. And the holy Magid of Terhovitsa leaped from the table and said with burning arousal: "I thought it was Reb Noson — but now I see it is Rabbainu himself!" And the essential root of the controversy of the Rabbi of Savran against Reb Noson was that Moharan'as bound himself with great self-sacrifice so that Rabbainu's matter should endure for all generations — and he would not allow the Rabbi of Savran to marry Idel the daughter of Rabbainu, for this would have been a great harm to Rabbainu's legacy. And when the match was being discussed, Idel asked the Rabbi of Savran: "I have heard you dispute with my father." He replied: "Not with your father — only with his disciple [Moharan'as], who said your father is as great as Moshe Rabbainu." She replied: "What is the difference? Moshe Rabbainu brought down the Torah — and my father brings people to fulfill it." And the match was not completed, for Moharan'as did not agree.
